svg.title: How to read a time series graph: the parts of a series
svg.desc: Top: 15 days of simulated building power demand, with labels for the upward trend, the daily and weekly cycle, a one-reading outlier, a six-hour gap where the meter was offline, and a level shift where demand drops by 12 kW. Below, the same series split into three parts that add up to it: the trend with its level shift, the repeating daily and weekly cycle, and the irregular noise that is left over.
svg.text: Simulated 15-minute readings of a building's power demand
Drops when the retrofit goes live
Repeats every day; smaller at weekends
The same series, split into three parts that add up to it
One series, four parts: observed = trend + cycle + noise
